forum.title: NUCLEO-U5A5ZJ-Q default configuration
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi,

set crystal:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/fdea77c5-fa3e-44b4-b2fc-746119feb664.png)

..and clock tree :  pll 1P  to 16 M !

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c3dd2da1-6acb-4a87-b95a-7c71c6ea14c3.png)

because usb needs it:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/534729f9-e34e-4ffe-91af-239fdb423733.png)

+

on nucleo U5A5  the clock is coming from the st-link , in first version (?), so 8Mhz , + “bypass” is correct setting.

Look, what is really on your board : if the 16M crystal is there, then 16M + “crystal..” is correct, maybe necent version, then clock tree:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1ee83738-d2b6-4215-9434-f77cd9d6cfd9.png)

and can use it for USB also:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/bd33a454-ef06-4f29-b32e-b9349e022d3b.png)
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am currently trying to setup a blink example on NUCLEO-U5A5ZJ-Q and I have a bug using the default configuration from current CubeMX version (6.18.1).

The generated binary ends up in an Error Handler in the SystemClock\_Config function. The default clock configuration generated is the following:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/eb5c7275-249b-4523-ae7c-88f190c99646.png)

I have noticed that a similar issue has been notified in

<https://community.st.com/stm32cubemx-mcus-29/default-cubemx-project-for-nucleo-u5a5zj-error-in-systemclock-config-162303>

I have tried to use the bypasses mentioned in the previous post (setting the HSE source to 16 MHz, changing the SYSCLK Mux source, etc.) without success. Particularly, I am not able to find the setting allowing me to set HSE to “Crystal/Ceramic Resonator” in my CubeMX version.

Thanks in advance for helping me resolve this setup issue,

Best regards,

Robin
